resources.title: Academy trusts: governance guide
resources.audience: Academy trustees, members, local governors and governance professionals
resources.summary: A reference for trust leadership, board roles and legal responsibilities. Read alongside the trust’s funding agreement and the relevant academy trust handbook.
resources.access: Free to read and download; no account, membership or registration required.

resources.title: Maintained schools: governance guide
resources.audience: Governors and governance professionals in local-authority-maintained schools
resources.summary: A reference for the governing body’s role and responsibilities, including strategic leadership, curriculum, safeguarding and inclusion.
resources.access: Free to read and download; no account, membership or registration required.

resources.summary: The 2026 statutory safeguarding guidance is in force from 1 September 2026. Governing bodies, proprietors and management committees should use the full guidance for their responsibilities.
resources.access: Free to read and download; no account, membership or registration required.
resources.audience: School and college governing bodies, proprietors, management committees and staff

resources.title: SEN and disabilities: guidance for school governing boards
resources.audience: Maintained-school governors, academy trustees and committees with delegated duties
resources.summary: A practical introduction to board oversight of SEN and disability, with a checklist and advice on using information to support and challenge leaders.
resources.access: Free to read and download; no account, membership or registration required.

resources.summary: The statutory SEND code for education, health and local-authority bodies. Use it alongside the board-specific guidance when considering provision, participation and responsibilities.
resources.access: Free to read and download; no account, membership or registration required.
resources.source: Department for Education and Department of Health and Social Care

resources.summary: The national curriculum framework and subject programmes for England. Local-authority-maintained schools must teach these programmes; check the duties that apply to your own school or trust.
resources.access: Free to read and download; no account, membership or registration required.
resources.audience: Maintained-school governors and leaders; trustees considering curriculum provision

resources.summary: The academy trust financial and governance handbook in force until 30 September 2026. Trusts must comply with the relevant handbook as a condition of their funding agreement.
resources.access: Free to read and download; no account, membership or registration required.
resources.audience: Academy members, trustees, accounting officers, finance leaders and auditors

resources.summary: The next academy trust handbook takes effect on 1 October 2026. Use it to prepare for the change; the 2025 handbook remains in force until then.
resources.access: Free to read and download; no account, membership or registration required.
resources.audience: Academy members, trustees, accounting officers, finance leaders and auditors

resources.title: NGA events and networks
resources.audience: Governors, trustees, chairs and governance professionals
resources.summary: Explore conferences, webinars, leadership forums and networks. Availability depends on event type and, for some events, your membership level.
resources.access: Mixed access. Conferences and several networks are member-only; webinars are open to members and non-members. Booking and any fee depend on the event.

resources.title: NGA webinars
resources.summary: Browse governance updates and recorded discussions. Topics include safeguarding, inclusion, accountability and working with school leaders.
resources.access: Most webinars are free to everyone, including non-members. Live attendance requires booking; check the individual event for fees and access conditions.

resources.title: An introduction to governance with NGA
resources.audience: Governors and trustees in their first six months
resources.summary: Online introductory sessions tailored to maintained-school governors, local governors, single-academy trustees and multi-academy trustees.
resources.access: NGA Gold or MAT membership required. No additional session charge for eligible members; booking required.

resources.title: Boards for Education learning hub
resources.source: Boards for Education (formerly Governors for Schools)
resources.jurisdiction: England and Wales; choose the relevant national guidance
resources.audience: Prospective and serving governors, academy trustees and other education board volunteers
resources.summary: Find governance resources, webinars and eLearning, with separate England and Wales signposting. Recorded webinars reflect guidance at the time they were made.
resources.access: Public resource pages are free to browse. Live webinars require registration; eLearning uses an account. Some courses, including the induction series, require payment.

resources.title: Become an Effective New School Governor
resources.jurisdiction: England; separate maintained-school and academy-governor courses
resources.audience: New school governors and people preparing to become governors
resources.summary: An induction series with role-specific modules, terminology, examples, quizzes and videos from governors. Choose the course for your school type.
resources.access: Paid, with account access: £30 per individual including VAT, or £150 plus VAT for a whole board. Provider states lifetime access from purchase; check terms before buying.

resources.jurisdiction: Teacher-created materials; check suitability for your own setting
resources.audience: Governors and trustees exploring teaching with school leaders
resources.summary: Look through lesson sequences, schemes and teaching packs to discuss how learning builds over time. These are classroom materials, not an official governance or inspection framework.
resources.access: Free to read and download; no account, membership or registration required.

resources.jurisdiction: Teacher-created materials; check suitability for your own setting
resources.audience: Governors and trustees exploring teaching with school leaders
resources.summary: Explore the existing BUILD ASDAN learning collection. Use real activities to discuss access, participation and meaningful next steps for learners.
resources.access: Free to read and download; no account, membership or registration required.

resources.jurisdiction: Teacher-created materials; check suitability for your own setting
resources.audience: Governors and trustees exploring teaching with school leaders
resources.summary: Browse worksheets, downloads and resource collections, including older materials. Ask how a selected resource fits the school’s own curriculum and pupils’ needs.
resources.access: Free to read and download; no account, membership or registration required.

resources.jurisdiction: Teacher-created materials; check suitability for your own setting
resources.audience: Governors and trustees exploring teaching with school leaders
resources.summary: Follow the teaching and planning routes to see the materials behind a sequence. Explore these with school leaders when discussing provision and classroom support.
resources.access: Free to read and download; no account, membership or registration required.
